scenario: Two entries share an identical ISO 8601 timestamp
note: Accepted silently, and correctly so: entry ordering and chain integrity are driven entirely by append() call order and causal_parent_id, not by timestamp uniqueness. Because computePrevSpanHash() includes each entry's own decision/kernel_id/etc plus the running prev_span_hash, two entries with identical timestamps still produce distinct own_span_hash values (confirmed above) and the chain still verifies clean. Draft is silent on timestamp uniqueness, but no ambiguity actually exists in the sample implementation — this is normative text absent, but no code decision was needed. Code comment added clarifying timestamp is descriptive metadata, not an ordering key.
